title: Abandonment.
bodyText: Any owner of any stream diversion work wishing to abandon or remove such work shall first obtain a permit to do so from the commission.
bodyHtml: [§174C-95]  Abandonment.  Any owner of any stream diversion work wishing to abandon or remove such work shall first obtain a permit to do so from the commission. [L 1987, c 45, pt of §2]
